ledger_summary.denominator: The discovery ledger includes other years, offices and non-district/generic records. Excluded records are not all current House polls or quality rejections.

interpretation: Public availability is approximated by the later of fieldwork end and aggregator creation plus one day; original publication times remain unverified.
One eligible question per sample and district; latest eligible sample per pollster and district. Likely voters are preferred to registered voters, then adults.
Shared cycle, district, pollster and movement covariance is modeled. Nominal sample size is not separately added to historically calibrated total error.
Reported party/internal labels are metadata, not numeric pollster ratings or a separate quality weight.
The modeled share conditions on the two named principal candidates; later RCV rounds and departed or hypothetical lineups are excluded.
Native race.poll_source_ids must equal the selected observation IDs for its district under polling configurations and be empty for fundamentals-only configurations.
